high_level_description: The image shows a vintage electronic device that appears to be a combination of a watch and a calculator. The device is predominantly silver with a black keyboard-like section on the top half and a digital display screen on the bottom left side. The screen displays some text, though it is not entirely clear what it says due to the resolution. The watch band is also silver and has a metallic, segmented design. The text at the bottom of the image reads: "According to the company, the watch was the 'first of its kind'.
